features.true_meaning: total payload of FORWARD packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 1, same source IP as the flow's first packet)
count of FORWARD packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 1)
mean payload of FORWARD packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 1)
total payload of REVERSE packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 0)
count of REVERSE packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 0)
mean payload of REVERSE packets in the slot (pkts_dir == 0)
total_payload_forward / total_payload_reverse (index 0 / index 3), and 0 when the denominator is 0. It is a PAYLOAD-SIZE ratio, not a packet-count ratio.
slot_index * window_seconds; identical for every flow, so it carries no per-sample information

boundary_rule: slot = min(elapsed_ns // window_ns, T-1) in EXACT INTEGER NANOSECONDS; a packet exactly on a boundary enters the UPPER slot; a packet exactly at elapsed == D is included
